title: 34:11 cormorant/bittern/owl/raven. These (and the others listed) are unclean creatures that inhabit lands made desolate by God (13:21-22; Jer. 50:39). (Some translate cormorant as "desert owl" and bittern as "screech owl.") These creatures inhabited ancient Edom after its destruction. They and their desolate dwelling places symbolize telestial domains. Their existence in Edom reveals the completeness of its ruin and desolation. Similarly, at the Second Coming, the world (Edom) will be destroyed, and all corruptible things will be consumed.
author: Tina M. Peterson
